name: Grok Apron
tagline: Turns the week's grocery circular into a family menu and a ready cart
description: Read the store's circular and it plans the week's meals around what is actually on sale, sized for a family rather than a meal-prep single. It then assembles the matching cart in the store's own online ordering, ready for a pickup or a delivery run, and stops there - the checkout itself stays with you.
author: Handicapper_Gen
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
